label: Account
账户
description: Manage your sign-in, team, and saved accounts
管理你的登录、团队和已保存的账户

label: Theme
主题
description: Pick the light or dark look for Grok Bot
为 Grok Bot 选择浅色或深色外观

label: Accent
强调色
description: Color 1:1 Bot messages and cards with the Bot's color, or keep them black
用 Bot 的颜色为 1:1 Bot 消息和卡片上色，或保持黑色

label: Language
语言
description: Choose the language Grok Bot uses for menus and messages
选择 Grok Bot 菜单和消息使用的语言

label: Check Spelling While Typing
输入时检查拼写
description: Underline misspelled words as you type
输入时为拼写错误的单词加下划线

label: Microphone
麦克风
description: Choose which microphone Grok Bot listens to when you talk to it
选择你和 Grok Bot 说话时使用的麦克风

label: Use hardware acceleration
使用硬件加速
description: Let your graphics card draw the app, or turn it off if the window flickers or stays blank
让显卡来绘制应用；如果窗口闪烁或一直空白，请关闭此选项

label: Restart to Apply
重启以应用
description: Restart Grok Bot so the graphics change takes effect
重启 Grok Bot 以使图形设置的更改生效

label: Network Debugger
网络调试器
description: Check Grok Bot's connection
检查 Grok Bot 的连接

label: Play Sound for Notifications
为通知播放声音
description: Turn the sound that plays when Grok Bot sends you a message on or off
开启或关闭 Grok Bot 给你发消息时播放的声音

label: Notification Sound
通知声音
description: Pick the sound that plays when Grok Bot sends you a message
选择 Grok Bot 给你发消息时播放的声音

label: Model
模型
description: Choose which AI model Grok Bot thinks with
选择 Grok Bot 用来思考的模型

label: Timezone
时区
description: Set the time zone Grok Bot uses for schedules and reminders
设置 Grok Bot 用于日程和提醒的时区

label: Execution on Local Computer
在本地电脑上执行
description: Allow Grok Bot to run tasks on this computer, not only on its own computer
允许 Grok Bot 在这台电脑上运行任务，而不只是在它自己的电脑上

label: Your computer
你的电脑
description: See and manage the computers Grok Bot can work on
查看和管理 Grok Bot 可以使用的电脑

label: Import cookies from Chrome
从 Chrome 导入 Cookie
description: Copy your Chrome logins to Grok Bot's computer so it can use the sites you are signed in to
把你的 Chrome 登录信息复制到 Grok Bot 的电脑，让它能使用你已登录的网站

label: Use Messages
使用「消息」
description: Lets Grok Bot read and send texts on this Mac
允许 Grok Bot 在这台 Mac 上读取和发送消息

label: Send Without Asking
无需询问直接发送
description: Choose whether Grok Bot asks before it sends a text
选择 Grok Bot 是否在发送消息前询问

label: Allowed recipients
允许的收件人
description: Manage who Grok Bot can text without asking first
管理 Grok Bot 无需事先询问即可发送消息的对象

label: Auto-review
自动审核
description: Choose how closely Grok Bot checks its own risky actions before it runs them
选择 Grok Bot 在执行有风险的操作前要检查得多仔细

label: Custom Rules
自定义规则
description: Set rules for which actions Grok Bot can take automatically
为 Grok Bot 可以自动执行的操作设置规则

label: Use hardware security keys
使用硬件安全密钥
description: Require a hardware security key, like a YubiKey, for sensitive actions
敏感操作需要使用硬件安全密钥（如 YubiKey）

label: Clear connector preferences
清除连接器偏好设置
description: Remove any preferences you have set with Team Bots which give them access to your personal connectors
移除你为团队 Bot 设置的、允许其访问你个人连接器的所有偏好设置

label: Slack account
Slack 账号
description: Link your Slack account to Cursor so Team Bots and Cloud Agents know who you are in Slack
将你的 Slack 账号关联到 Cursor，让团队 Bot 和云端智能体知道你在 Slack 中的身份

label: Passkeys
通行密钥
description: Save a passkey so Grok Bot can confirm it's you before it approves a purchase
保存通行密钥，让 Grok Bot 在批准购买前确认是你本人

label: Usage
用量
description: See your included usage and when it resets
查看你的附带用量及其重置时间

label: Manage Plan
管理计划
description: See your plan, change it, or update billing
查看或更换你的计划，或更新账单信息

label: Cancel Trial
取消试用
description: End your free trial early
提前结束你的免费试用

label: On-Demand
按需用量
description: Allow extra usage beyond your plan, billed as you go
允许超出计划的额外用量，按实际使用计费

label: Manage Billing
管理账单
description: Manage your billing on Cursor
在 Cursor 上管理你的账单

label: Route traffic through this computer
经此电脑转发流量
description: Send Grok Bot's internet traffic through this desktop instead of its own computer
让 Grok Bot 的网络流量经由本机而非它自己的电脑发出

label: Grok Bot Updates
Grok Bot 更新
description: See which version of Grok Bot you have and whether an update is ready
查看你的 Grok Bot 版本，以及是否有可用更新

label: Update Track
更新通道
description: Choose whether Grok Bot installs stable releases only or tries beta builds early
选择 Grok Bot 只安装稳定版，还是提前尝试测试版

label: Automatic Updates
自动更新
description: Let Grok Bot install updates on its own
让 Grok Bot 自行安装更新

label: Update Bot's Computer
更新 Bot 的电脑
description: Install the latest software on Grok Bot's computer and keep your files in place
在 Grok Bot 的电脑上安装最新软件，并保留你的文件

label: Reset Bot's Computer
重置 Bot 的电脑
description: Restart Grok Bot's computer from your last saved snapshot if it gets stuck
Grok Bot 的电脑卡住时，从你上次保存的快照重启它
